camel_example: aliyun eiam EnableResourceServerCustomSubject --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx
description_en: Enables the custom subject feature for a specified resource server. After this feature is enabled, the subject of an issued access token changes from <clientId> to <clientId>:<client.activeSubjectUrn>. The `client.activeSubjectUrn` is set in the attribute mapping of the application's federated identity provider
description_zh: 启用指定ResourceServer的自定义Subject能力（开启自定义主体后，签发的 Access Token 将从(clientld) 变成 <clientld>:<client.activeSubjectUrn>，其中 client.activeSubjectUrn 在应用的联邦凭证的属性映射中设置）
kebab_example: aliyun eiam enable-resource-server-custom-subject --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableResourceServerCustomSubject
